title: First Bank Announces Second Quarter 2025 Earnings Conference Call
summary: HAMILTON, N.J., July 02, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - First Bank (Nasdaq Global Market: FRBA) invites participation in a conference call to discuss the Company’s financial and operating performance during its second quarter ending on June 30, 2025. Event: Earnings Conference Call – Second Quarter 2025 When: Wednesday, July 23, 2025 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time Access: Conference Call Dial-In: (800) 715-9871 (toll free) Conference Call Access Code: 3909613 Patrick L. Ryan, President and Chief Executive Officer, Andrew L. Hibshman, Chief Financial Officer, Peter J. Cahill, Chief Lending Officer, and Darleen Gillespie, Chief Retail Banking Officer will provide an overview of second quarter 2025 results. The management presentation typically lasts approximately fifteen to thirty minutes, followed by investor questions and discussion. The Company’s second quarter results will be released after the market closes on Tuesday, July 22, 2025 and will also be available in the “Investor Relations”
